a.q: A writer spells a character's greeting as "G'day mate, howya goin". What is the main effect of this spelling?
opts: It shows the character speaks in a relaxed way
It shows the writer does not know the standard spelling
It makes the character seem more formal and polite
It gives the reader accurate facts about the setting
a.why: The spelling copies the sound of casual speech, so the reader hears the character's voice. It is not an error, because the writer chose it on purpose, and it does not sound formal.
a.clue: Say the greeting aloud and think about how it sounds.
